title: Compute perturbation coefficients and ground-state energy
action: For each lattice type (chain, square plane, simple cubic, body-centered cubic) and each spin magnitude j in {0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5}, determine the lattice parameters (coordination number z and geometric factor Q), compute the perturbation expansion coefficients c1 and c2 using the formulas provided in the instruction, and for the isotropic case (γ=0) and j=0.5, also compute the ground-state energy per bond in units of −J z N ħ²/2. Output all results as a structured JSON file.
description: JSON file containing computed perturbation coefficients c1, c2 and ground-state energy values for antiferromagnetic lattices.
output_schema: Object with top-level keys 'chain', 'plane', 'sc', 'bcc'. Each value is an object with keys '0.5','1.0','1.5','2.0','2.5'. Each entry is an object: 'c1' (float), 'c2' (float). For j=0.5 only, additionally 'E_gamma0' (float).
